title: QUIZ - 78
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Identifying the Y-Intercept from an Equation
questions.learningObjective: Identify the y-intercept of a line from its slope-intercept equation
questions.question: What is the y-intercept of the line \( y = 3t + 10 \)?
questions.explanation: In y = mt + b form, the constant term b is the y-intercept. Here, b = 10.
questions.hint: In y = mx + b form, the y-intercept is the constant term b.

questions.explanation: In y = mn + b form, the constant term b is the y-intercept. Here, b = -7.
questions.hint: In y = mx + b form, the y-intercept is the constant term b.

questions.concept: Finding the Y-Intercept from a Point and Slope
questions.learningObjective: Determine a line's y-intercept given one point and the slope
questions.question: A line passes through (1, -2) and has a slope of 5. What is its y-intercept?
questions.hint: Substitute the known point and slope into y = mx + b, then solve for b.

questions.concept: Interpreting the Y-Intercept in Context
questions.learningObjective: Interpret the real-world meaning of a y-intercept in a linear model
questions.question: In a linear model of a tank's water level over time as it drains, the y-intercept is 382. What does this value represent?

options.label: A
options.text: The rate of change, which is 382 per unit.

options.label: B
options.text: The maximum possible value, which is 382.

options.label: C
options.text: The water level at the very start, which is 382.

options.label: D
options.text: The final value after all time has passed, which is 382.

questions.explanation: The y-intercept is the value of the model when the input is 0, representing the water level at the very start.
questions.hint: The y-intercept is the value of the quantity when the input variable is zero — the starting point.
